title: [finding] check-agent-model-declared's header will point at os-dev.md for "the full order and both adjacent traps" once the model-pin comment shrinks to a pointer back at it
body:
Blocked-by: #12800

Filed unassigned by the dev seat delivering PR #14229 (session `session_01Whev4BkZ4BRcgiXYo4muWP`), which could not fix it in scope: that PR is fenced to the single governed file `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`.

## What becomes stale, and when

`scripts/check-agent-model-declared.mjs`'s header currently says, of the `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` env var: "outranks every other step, including this gate's own pin — see `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` for the full order and both adjacent traps."

PR #14229 (the ratchet-funded delivery for the pair whose chain head is the card named above) shrinks os-dev.md's model-pin comment to a two-line pointer whose destination is this very gate's header. Once that PR merges, the two comments point at each other, and the os-dev.md side no longer carries "the full order and both adjacent traps" in expanded form.

## Why nothing is lost (and why this is still worth one line)

The gate header itself already states the full resolution order, the batched-death incident (in more detail than os-dev.md ever did), and both traps — the env var outranking everything, and the org-allowlist fallback landing on the INHERITED model. So no information is unreachable; the defect is only that the header's "see os-dev.md for the full order" sentence describes the pre-#14229 file. One-line fix in the gate script's comment once #14229 lands: make the header claim itself as the home (which it factually is) instead of deferring to os-dev.md.

## Scope note

Comment-only drift in a script header; no behavior change; `scripts/` is not governed surface. Dedup 2026-09-01: targeted `search_issues` returned 8 hits, none open on this axis (the closed twin from 2026-08 was the inverse direction — the header omitting the env var, since fixed).
